extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: fairy-tale castle, curtain wall 24 x 20 m with four round corner towers, approx. 32 x 30 m footprint incl. gatehouse and approach, keep 34 m tall incl. flag
extras.notes: exterior only (closed buildings, opaque windows, no interior); front (gatehouse) faces -Y; the two gate leaves (castle_gate_leaf_left/right) are separate objects with their origin on the vertical hinge axis at the outer edge of the arch (rotate around local Z to open); wall walk with crenellations, courtyard with lawn and paths; no emblems, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
